第一卷 第24章 云阳魔族（第1页）
林枫一路疾驰，终于赶回了落脚的客栈。
屋内柳雨姝、赤瑶听到动静同时睁眼，去打开了门。
见林枫嘴角带着血丝、气息微微紊乱，两个徒弟瞬间担忧起来。
“嗯遇到个老牌魔修，实力极强，此地不宜久留。马上收拾东西，咱们换个地方落脚。”
柳雨姝收拾东西，赤瑶去叫醒隔壁的王肖，而后一行人跟着林枫，离开了云阳城地界。
天边泛起鱼肚白时，众人踏入隔壁的清临城。
刚落脚安顿，柳雨姝便忍不住问道：“师尊，那黑袍魔修，实力很强吗？”
她从未见过师尊负伤，哪怕上次对战金丹七层的魔修老者，师尊也毫发无损。
林枫淡淡开口：“极强，至少元婴起步。”
此话一出，在场几人皆是心头一震。
谁也没想到，这样顶尖的魔修，竟然会藏在云阳城中。
“那地底魔铃，是罕见的惑心魔器。”林枫缓缓解释，“能放大人的七情六欲、干扰神智，长期以生人欲念滋润此器，幕后之人的目的绝不简单。”
赤瑶攥紧手中的剑，眉眼凌厉：“这群魔修藏头露尾，太过阴毒！”
柳雨姝声音低落道：“只怪我们现在修为太低，不然就可以和师父三打一了。”
“无妨。”林枫轻笑道，“现在好好修炼，会有那一天的。”
几人暂且在清临城一处僻静院落住下，继续使用聚灵丹突破。
院落之中灵气缭绕，两道强横气息接连炸开！

先是柳雨姝周身白光暴涨，突破到筑基九层。
紧接着赤瑶身上赤焰冲天，也突破到炼气八层。
大门外林枫负着手，缓步走回来，身后的王肖拎着打包的饭菜，笑嘻嘻地举着晃了晃。
“听闻这清临城中有一处落霞秘境，里面灵气浓郁，妖兽众多，还有不少天材地宝。”
“休休整两日，过两日我们进秘境闭关历练。”
一行人备好丹药法器，直奔落霞秘境入口。
秘境山门矗立在群山之间，氤氲灵气扑面而来。
入口处人流涌动，全是各地赶来历练的散修和宗门弟子。
“听说秘境深处有千年灵药，甚至还有上古传承，就看谁有机缘。”
“大家小心点，里面妖兽很凶残的，不少修士还会暗中夺宝杀人……”
耳边嘈杂议论不断，各色修士扎堆。
就在这时，三道身着宗门服饰的男女，带着一众弟子缓步走来，瞬间成为全场议论的焦点。
“是赤霞宗的人！东域二流顶尖宗门！”
“领头的赤霞宗少宗主燕宸，听说才年仅二十五，修为已是金丹四层。”
“完了，有赤霞宗一行人在，秘境里的好资源，咱们根本抢不到……”
燕宸一袭红袍，眉眼高傲，目光扫过众人，宛如俯视蝼蚁。
当他视线落在明艳张扬的赤瑶身上时，瞳孔微微一亮，眼底飞快闪过浓烈的占有欲。
他侧身跟身后师弟低语两句，独自迈步上前，径直拦住了林枫几人的去路。
燕宸姿态故作儒雅，看向赤瑶：“我乃赤霞宗少宗主燕宸。第一眼见你便觉得十分亲切，想和你交个朋友。不如你跟我我们一起，如此一来收获会更多。”
他又瞥了一眼林枫和王肖，问到：“这几位是你什么人呢？”

Volume 1 Chapter 24 Yunyang Demon Clan (Page 1)
Lin Feng galloped all the way and finally rushed back to the inn where he stayed.
Inside the house, Liu Yushu and Chiyao opened their eyes at the same time when they heard the noise and went to open the door.
Seeing that the corners of Lin Feng's mouth were bloodshot and his breath was slightly disordered, the two apprentices instantly became worried.
"Well, I met an old demon cultivator who is extremely powerful. It's not suitable to stay here for a long time. Pack your things immediately and let's find another place to stay."
Liu Yushu packed her things, while Chiyao went to wake up Wang Xiao next door, and then the group followed Lin Feng and left the boundary of Yunyang City.
When the sky turned white, everyone stepped into Qinglin City next door.
As soon as she settled down, Liu Yushu couldn't help but ask: "Master, is that black-robed demon cultivator very strong?"
She had never seen her master injured. Even in the last battle against an old demon cultivator at the seventh level of the golden elixir, his master was unscathed.
Lin Feng said calmly: "Extremely strong, at least Nascent Soul starts."
As soon as these words came out, everyone present was shocked.
No one expected that such a top demon cultivator would be hiding in Yunyang City.
"That underground magic bell is a rare mind-bewitching magic weapon." Lin Feng slowly explained, "It can amplify people's emotions and interfere with their sanity. It has been nourishing this device with human desires for a long time. The purpose of the person behind the scenes is by no means simple."
Chi Yao clenched the sword in her hand tightly, her eyebrows sharp: "These demon cultivators hide their heads and show their tails, they are too vicious!"
Liu Yushu said in a low voice: "It's just that our cultivation level is too low now, otherwise we would be able to fight Master three against one."
"It doesn't matter." Lin Feng chuckled, "Practice hard now, and one day you will get there."
A few people temporarily stayed in a secluded courtyard in Qinglin City and continued to use the Spirit Gathering Pill to break through.
The courtyard was filled with spiritual energy, and two powerful auras exploded one after another!
First, the white light around Liu Yushu surged, breaking through to the ninth level of the foundation.
Immediately afterwards, the red flames on Chi Yao's body soared into the sky, and she also broke through to the eighth level of Qi refining.
Outside the gate, Lin Feng walked back slowly with his hands clasped behind his back. Wang Xiao behind him was holding the packed meal and shaking it with a smile.
"I heard that there is a secret realm of Luoxia in Qinglin City. It has rich spiritual energy, many monsters and beasts, and many natural and earthly treasures."
"Take a rest for two days. In the next two days, we will enter the secret realm to practice in seclusion."
The group prepared their elixirs and magic weapons and headed straight to the entrance of Luoxia Secret Realm.
The secret mountain gate stands among the mountains, and the dense spiritual energy blows towards your face.
There was a huge flow of people at the entrance, all casual cultivators and sect disciples who came from all over to practice.
"I heard that there are thousand-year-old elixirs deep in the secret realm, and there are even ancient inheritances. It depends on who has the chance."
"Everyone, be careful. The monsters inside are very ferocious, and many monks will steal treasures and kill people secretly..."
There were noisy discussions in the ears, and monks of all kinds gathered together.
At this moment, three men and women dressed in sect costumes slowly walked over with a group of disciples, and instantly became the focus of discussion.
"They are from the Chixia Sect! The second-rate top sect in the Eastern Region!"
"The leading young master of the Chixia Sect, Yan Chen, is said to be only twenty-five years old, and his cultivation level is already at the fourth level of the Golden Core."
"It's over. With the Chixia Sect and the others here, we can't grab the good resources in the secret realm at all..."
Yan Chen was dressed in red robes, with arrogant eyebrows, and his eyes swept over the crowd, as if he were looking down at ants.
When his eyes fell on the bright and flamboyant Chi Yao, his pupils lit up slightly, and a strong possessiveness flashed through his eyes.
He turned sideways and whispered to the junior brother behind him, stepped forward alone, and directly blocked the path of Lin Feng and others.
Yan Chen pretended to be elegant and looked at Chi Yao: "I am Yan Chen, the young master of Chixia Sect. When I first saw you, I felt very friendly and wanted to make friends with you. Why don't you come with me? You will gain more this way."
He glanced at Lin Feng and Wang Xiao again and asked, "Who are these people? "
